title: Stomp Farm
features:
Stomp Farming made easy in Da Hills with various configurable settings.

including:
Teleport to Safe Spot: Automatically teleports when HP is low.
Cooldown Time: Adjustable time between farming actions.
Minimum Health to Farm: Sets a threshold for minimum health before farming continues.
StompFarmEnabled: Option to enable or disable Stomp farming.

It should be compatible with Solara, Xeno, and similar executors. This script has been tested on AWP
